materia.por: By Brazilian Red Cross — Rio de Janeiro Branch
para_entender_itens: The Brazilian Red Cross is part of the largest humanitarian movement in the world, present in 191 countries.
In Rio de Janeiro, the branch works in emergencies, community health and training.
The work is carried out by volunteers from the city itself.

campanha.titulo: Winter Clothing Drive | Brazilian Red Cross Rio de Janeiro
campanha.descricao: Donate coats, blankets and shoes to the Brazilian Red Cross Rio de Janeiro Winter Clothing Drive and help families face the cold. Here is how to take part.
campanha.linha: Every year, the cold arrives before the care does. Families in vulnerable situations face cold nights without a blanket, a coat or closed shoes. The Brazilian Red Cross — Rio de Janeiro Branch is mobilised to bring warmth, dignity and hope to those who need it most.
fotos: A Brazilian Red Cross Rio de Janeiro volunteer hands a blanket to a person living on the street in Rio de Janeiro.
Families in vulnerable situations need warm clothing, blankets and care when it is cold.
A Brazilian Red Cross Rio de Janeiro volunteer at a winter clothing distribution in a low-income neighbourhood of Rio de Janeiro.
Every item donated helps someone get through the winter with more dignity.
campanha.caso_titulo: When the cold comes, people without shelter suffer first
caso_paragrafos: In the coldest seasons of the year, the basic needs of people living on the street or in vulnerable situations become more acute: warmth, protection, hygiene and reliable information. The Winter Clothing Drive exists to channel people's generosity and turn donations into well-organised humanitarian aid.
campanha.caso_destaque: Giving quickly matters. Giving the right way is essential. Donated items must be clean, sorted and in line with the campaign team's guidance.
campanha.cartaz_alt: Official poster of the Brazilian Red Cross Rio de Janeiro Winter Clothing Drive, in Portuguese.
campanha.itens_linha: Sorting avoids waste and gets help to people faster. These are the items that can be dropped off at the headquarters.
itens: Clean items in good condition, sorted by type and size wherever possible.
Clean blankets and throws, without tears, ready for immediate use.
Socks, gloves, hats, scarves and long-sleeved tops in good condition.
Closed shoes, in pairs, following the campaign team's guidance.
campanha.como_linha: You can donate online, by card or PIX, or drop off items at the headquarters of the Brazilian Red Cross — Rio de Janeiro Branch.
como: Choose the amount and pay by card or PIX on the official donation page. The page is in Portuguese; the English donation page explains each step, and who can use it from outside Brazil.
Monday to Friday, 10am to 5pm, at Praça da Cruz Vermelha, 10 — Centro, Rio de Janeiro. For large quantities or items not on the list, write to the team first.
agradecimento_paragrafos: People who donate online to the Winter Clothing Drive will, in the future, receive access to free recorded courses offered by the Brazilian Red Cross — Rio de Janeiro Branch, as a thank-you for their humanitarian support.
campanha.agradecimento_nota: Please note: the courses will be offered free of charge to online donors once the recorded-content area is available. The courses are in Portuguese.
campanha.fila_alt: A community receiving winter clothing donations from the Brazilian Red Cross Rio de Janeiro.
campanha.principios_titulo: Humanitarian aid needs clear criteria, care and transparency
campanha.principios_linha: The Red Cross acts according to the principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality and independence. The campaign organises resources so that help arrives more safely and effectively.
principios: Items are organised to avoid waste, duplication and delays in the response.
Aid must first meet the most urgent needs of the families affected by the cold.
The official address for questions, partnerships and confirming priority items.
campanha.final_titulo: Your donation helps bring warmth and hope to those who need it most
campanha.final_texto: Someone may be waiting for exactly the coat you can give today.
